description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the IncreaseInstance operation, which is used to create a batch task for an Image Search instance by name
description_zh: 本文为您介绍IncreaseInstance接口的语法及示例，用于根据名称新建图像搜索实例批量任务
kebab_example: aliyun imagesearch increase-instance --instance-name imagesearchName --bucket-name bucketName --path /xxx/xxx --callback-address http://xxxxx --api-version 2020-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IncreaseInstance

parameters.description_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the [Image Search console](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to [Activate the service](~~179178~~) and [Create an instance](~~66569~~).
>The instance name is not the instance ID. Make sure that you distinguish between the two.
parameters.description_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录[图像搜索管控台](https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考[开通服务](~~179178~~)和[创建实例](~~66569~~)。
>这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分。

parameters.description_en:
The absolute path of the increment.meta file in OSS. The path must start with a forward slash (/) and must not end with a forward slash (/).
> Prepare the increment.meta file in advance. For more information, see [Batch operations](~~66580~~).
parameters.description_zh:
OSS中increment.meta文件的绝对路径。必须"/"开头，非"/"结尾。
> 需要您提前准备increment.meta文件。具体请参见[批量操作](~~66580~~)。
